notes: Three faults found by working through every screen of a fresh install. Opening Google Fonts used to switch the font library's preview to Latin and leave it there, which removed the signal that a family is missing a subset; the preference is computed per view now. A font already in the library could be converted and uploaded a second time before the server refused it, because the check compared the picked file against names the server had rewritten. The Generated CSS preview showed a fallback the stylesheet does not contain and ignored the family's own stack. Everything else on that install behaved, including the converter, the Reinstall guard, trash and restore, import and export, preload, and the typography tokens reaching the front end.
